g.text: Entry points
Core
State
External
make · default target, tears down the old container and starts a new one
make clean, del-cont, del-img · stop, remove container, drop the image
make login, logs, inspect · docker exec and logs on the fixed name
localhost:8080 · the one published port, mapped to nginx port 80
docker-run recipe · no file of its own, so it fires on every make
DOCKERBUILDTOUCH · empty sentinel, its mtime decides whether to build
context/Dockerfile · nginx base, apt uvicorn + python3-fastapi, no app inside
start_uvicorn.sh · copied into docker-entrypoint.d as 40-start-uvicorn.sh
nginx.conf · / proxied to 127.0.0.1:8000, /index.html from the html mount
entry.py · FastAPI catch-all returning inline HTML plus the /static mount
static/ · index.html, script.js, style.css, served off the bind mount
docker run flags · --read-only root, html and app :ro, cache and pid rw
DOCKERBUILDTOUCH · zero bytes, its timestamp is the build cache
mnt_dirs/nginx-cache + nginx-pid · the only writable container paths
mnt_dirs/appdir + mnt_dirs/html · live source, mounted read-only
context/nginx.conf · captured once from a throwaway container, edited since
Docker engine · build, run, exec, inspect, fixed container and image name
nginx image and Debian packages · pulled on first build only
a browser on the host · the only client, no auth in front
